messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning a FlashAttention v2/v3 autoswitch rollout. Hit a p99 regression on long-chat/paged-KV traffic when enabling v3; looking for kernel selection heuristics + rollout flags.

tariq: can you paste the profiling snippet you saw? also, did batching window change when you flipped to v3?

maya: summary from local perf run (trimmed):
```
# profiler excerpt (summarized)
model: redwood-13b
kernel: flash_v3
seq: 4096
p50: 22ms -> 20ms
p99: 390ms -> 560ms (after KV regen)
kv_cache_hit: 0.86 -> 0.67
mem_peak: +1.2GB
```

elena: hm — v3 wins for short sequences but paged-KV churn + mem pressure looks like the culprit for the tail. did you try keeping v2 for paged paths (hybrid)?

maya: tried hybrid selector. Current heuristic prototype: runtime.attn_kernel = "auto" with rules:
- seq <= 1024 -> flash_v3
- seq > 1024 and kv_state == "paged" -> flash_v2
- otherwise -> flash_v3
Also added a backstop fflag: fflags.attn_fallback_to_v2 = true (route-level flip)

sam: rollout thoughts: staged canary with perf hooks. also consider lowering batch window during canary to avoid long prefix batches that amplify KV regen.

maya: propose rollout plan:
1) internal canary on dedicated pool (5 hosts), enable selector for 1% traffic
2) monitor metrics: p50/p99, kv_cache_hit, mem_rss, tokens/sec, and kernel_switches/sec
3) if p99 > baseline*1.25 OR kv_hit drops > 0.1 -> flip fflag.attn_fallback_to_v2 for that route
4) if stable 24h -> ramp 1% -> 5% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50%

tariq: add perf-bot metrics & alerts: emit `attn.kernel` metric with tags kernel=flash_v2|flash_v3|paged and kv_state=paged|native. perf-bot alert conditions: p99 > baseline*1.2 OR kv_hit_drop > 0.1 OR mem_peak delta > 1GB.

elena: also tune batch window for v3: default 8ms -> 5ms during canary; that reduces prefix batching and mem growth. test both batch windows on staging.

maya: will open PR for selector + fflags + dashboard mocks. Assignments: maya -> PR + infra checklist, tariq -> perf-bot metrics & alerts, sam -> rollout docs/runbook, elena -> staging validation (batch windows + long-chat). :thumbsup:

perf-bot: automated note — earlier staging alert sample: "attn.kernel=flash_v3 p99=1.35x baseline, kv_hit_drop=0.18" :warning:

maya: ack. I'll include a smoke script that toggles the route-level fflag and validates KV hit recovery. Will post a follow-up with PR link and quickstart for on-call to flip flag. Thanks everyone!
